registration.registration_scope: Local analysis specification fixed before any fold-2/fold-3 baseline test result was available; fold-1 results are already known and remain separately archived
registration.reference: Archived calibrated TREFIN on exactly matching fold-specific origin indices, targets and asset order
registration.difference_direction: Comparator minus TREFIN; positive favors TREFIN
registration.seed_treatment: Average the five seed losses at each origin before temporal inference; seeds are not independent temporal observations
registration.fold_treatment: Separate chronological origin series and tests within each fold; no pooling across folds or across seeds

bootstrap.sampling: Paired circular contiguous blocks within each fold, truncated to that fold's original origin count
bootstrap.confidence_interval: Unadjusted two-sided percentile 95% interval of uncentered block means
bootstrap.p_value: Two-sided null-centered block means with (1+exceedance count)/(10000+1)

multiplicity.bootstrap_scope: Separate six-comparison family for each loss and each block length
multiplicity.dm_scope: Separate six-comparison family for each loss
multiplicity.confidence_interval_scope: Holm adjusts p values only; reported per-comparison intervals are not simultaneous intervals
multiplicity.original_fold1_inference: Existing two-comparator fold-1 Holm outputs remain unchanged and separately labeled; expanded-family adjusted p values are new outputs

registration.dispersion: Arithmetic mean and sample SD over the five registered seeds
registration.completion_rule: No family/fold summary from fewer than all five registered completed runs; final crossfold inference requires all registered families and folds
excluded_operations: changing the primary multiplicity family after seeing fold-2/fold-3 test results

numerical_acceptance.decision_scope: Numerical implementation equivalence, not a forecasting-performance or significance result; decided before full optimized training and test evaluation
numerical_acceptance.additional_requirements: finite outputs; exact training losses/gradients; identical tested FFT top-k membership and rank
numerical_acceptance.TF32: disabled for matmul and cuDNN in both runner and diagnostic
numerical_acceptance.interpretation: Batch1 outputs are exact. Grouped CUDA differences start in finer-scale block outputs, with exact coarse FFT inputs/scores/selections; consistent with batch-shape-dependent float32 kernel roundoff. The fitted forecast RMS-relative discrepancy is about0.00295%, and maximum discrepancy is0.00617basispoints. This is not a bitwise-CUDA-equivalence claim or a guarantee for every possible input.
numerical_acceptance.rationale: Retain raw-return tolerance0.01basispoint as the primary observable-unit criterion, add normalized maximum and RMS-relative guards1e-4; the original2e-5 normalized guard was more restrictive than this documented implementation-agreement criterion. No model hyperparameter, data split, fitting objective, calibration rule or test outcome informed this numerical decision.
